Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Monopoly Go's free-gift reveal - a ribboned gift box that bursts open with light, scatters cash and dice, then unwraps a card pack into sticker cards that fan out under a Congratulations banner.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Store screen with a FREE gift banner. Claim stage (dark): a purple gift box with a yellow ribbon on a pedestal disc. The box opens: cash ("99.7M") and dice ("x2") pop out with light rays, confetti scatters, a dice shower follows. Then a gold Monopoly card pack rises, tears open, and reveals sticker cards ("Armor Up" and friends). End card: "CONGRATULATIONS! You received 3 Stickers!" with the three stickers displayed.

## Motion spec
Pattern: multi-stage gift unboxing.
- The gift box idles with a teasing wobble (rotation +-3deg, 1.5s loop) until tapped.
- Tap: the lid pops off (translateY -60px with spin, 300ms) on a white light flash; the cash and dice rewards spring out upward (stiffness ~320, damping ~18) and hang with labels.
- Confetti scatters (~30 pieces, 1s) then a dice shower rains from the top (~20 dice, tumbling, 800ms).
- The card pack rises from the bottom (spring, stiffness ~280, damping ~22), wiggles, and tears open (top strip peels with a 300ms zip); a sticker card flips out (rotationY 180 to 0, 400ms) showing its art and stars.
- The Congratulations banner drops from the top (spring, small bounce) as the three sticker cards fan into a row (each rotate-in +-10deg to 0, staggered 100ms).

## Calibration
- Each stage clears before the next enters - overlapping stages read as a bug, not abundance.
- The box wobble stops the instant the tap lands.

## Reduced motion
Box fades open, rewards fade in, cards fade into the row; no particles.

## Don't miss
- The light flash is the hinge between box and rewards - without it the pop-out feels unearned.
- Sticker cards are collectible cards with star ratings, not flat icons; keep the card chrome.
